No direct evidence of deployment issues, but memory spikes and resource exhaustion could theoretically stem from a faulty deployment. Lack of explicit logs or metrics supporting this reduces confidence.
No evidence of certificate-related errors or timeouts in logs or metrics. This is speculative and unlikely given the available data.
